content: Bab-Jehová-Bur-Gandik-Maid, we-negburgan anga oyosad: Reyga ibmar-gwag-orosgi-dakleged-ukleged-welesad-sorba, a-gwag gannar ainiali an dakalid. Agi Bab-Jehová sesmar-bukidar urbenai an dakarbalid.

Degi, sesmar napaneggi gaganse-bakale, bela obelosgua, binnasuli an goted: —An-Bab-Jehová-Bur-Gandik-Maidye, an bese wilesakwaa egisye, Jacob-waganga isgued be eliye. ¿Ar igi Jacob-wagande bar bukuosunna? Unnila ichee gumalad.
Degidgine, Bab-Jehová wiledakde, sogded: —Degir nabir, an deyob neg imakosulid.

Geb degi, Bab-Jehová-Bur-Gandik-Maid, negburgan-baid anse oyosbalid: An daked, Bab-Jehová dule-sabsur-odurdakega soose gote. Degi, soo napa-urba demar-wilasailad dinnaa imaksad. Degine, nainugan bela swanga imaksad.
Deyob an daksagu, binnasuli an goted: —Bab-Dummad-Jehováʼye, bese wilesakwaa an egisye, soo be oginye. Degisulile, ¿ar igi Jacob-wagande bar bukuosunna? Unnila iche gumalad.
Degidgine, Bab-Jehová wiledakde, sogded: —Degir nabir, an deyob neg imakosulid.
Bab-Jehová, anga negburgan-baid oyosbalid: An daked, Bab-Jehová galu-matusulid-nuekwa-sobaled-nagaba gwichi. Degi, neg-wilubsaed-dubgi-gingwa-naid e-argangi-gani, an dakalid.

Degi, Bab-Jehová anse egichialid: —Amós, ¿wede ibu be dake? An abin-sogded: —Dubgi gingwa-nai an daked. Degidgine, Bab-Jehová anga sogded: —Dubgi-gingwa-naidi, an-Israel-dulemar-abargi an obatoed, adi, wilubdakega, bule inniki-gudimardibeye. Inniki-gudisulile, bar an ega e-isgued eliosulid.

Degidgine, Betel-neggweburgined-dule-irwa-Babse-goled-Amasías, Israel-rey-Jeroboamʼga gayaburba barmisad: “Amós, Israel-sordamar-abargi begi gwisgudiid. Ar Amós-sunmakedba Israel-dulemar binsaed-galediid.
Geb degi, Amasías, Amósʼga sogded: —¡Dule-negburgan-daked, be wegi-gudiid be nae! Ar be mas-gunbiele, Judá-yarse be nae. Agi, Bab-Jehová-igargi be sunmaknae.
Melle bar Betel-neggweburgi, Bab-Jehová-igargi be sunmaknoniko, ar Betelʼde, rey-e-neg-islidikidid, rey-e-bab-dummadse-goled-negad.
Amós, Amasías-abin sogded: —An Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsoged-dulesulid, an a-machisurbalid. Unnila, an sibad-wawaad-edarbed-dule gued, higuera-sapigi an arbaed-dulebalid.
Degi-inigwele, Bab-Jehová sibad-edarbedgi an-onosad. Anga sogsad: ‘An-gayaburbagi be an-Israel-dulemarga be sunmaknaye.’
Degisoggu, Amasías, Bab-Jehová-gayaburba be itoge: ”Bede soged:
